not_measurable: Letter forms of SEMPER and VIGILANS: the banner faces are about 0.025 in wide (6 px of the photograph) and the letters are textured blobs. The 14 letters are font glyphs spaced evenly along each banner centre line (cap height 0.019 in); their forms and spacing are not measured. The banner plates themselves (outline, ends, size) are placed by measurement.

Individual feathers of the tail below the two broad caps, and the bow ribbon under them (loops, knot): 2 to 4 px structure. The caps, spine, bow loops and knot are placed by measurement; the fine feather lines are ridge centre lines of the photograph (tail group).

The cast ground between and around the objects: the photograph shows it in brighter and darker patches (about 45 to 95 in luminance) that the lit-class threshold (77) turns into blobs. The gate region (P.sel) is limited to the design envelope; the plain field outside it (corners of the hexagon, the area under the laurels) is left out of the gates.

The ring is drawn as a circle (centre -0.002, -0.568 in the flats frame, radius 0.1705 to the outer edge, 0.031 wide); the photograph shows it slightly tilted and its top is hidden by the ribbon. The bail is a plain rounded block: its specular streak (luminance up to 222) and the small cast pits are not drawn.
A speck above the emblem circle (about u 0.003, v -0.265) and the small cast marks left of the circle are not drawn.
fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B): every element is modelled as the object it is (letters, stars, wreath leaves, banner, aircraft ...) with its proportions measured from the photograph and placed by measurement; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge; upright. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph mask in the same box (lib-b.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B), upright. Measured from meritorious-service.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Hang angle -0.7 deg of the photograph removed. Hexagon body, lower vertex on the bottom of the miniature box (see FRAME in the generator). Objects: shell with a per-edge bevel (lit upper edges and flats, faint lower edges); suspension (ring, bail); circle emblem (ring, 8 horizontal bars, recessed triangle plate with outline, three-blade propeller); framed band with 11 raised capitals (MERITORIOUS); two banner plates with the curled outer ends drawn as scroll-tail ridges and SEMPER / VIGILANS lettered along them; eagle head (profile plate, recessed eye); two wings of feather ridges; tail (two caps, spine, feather lines, bow); two laurel branches (7 almond leaves each, stem). Ridge-bearing relief (feather rows, scroll tails, tail lines) is drawn from ridge centre lines found by a Steger ridge detector (sigma 0.0013 to 0.0018 in) on the upright photograph, merged into continuous chains (gaps under 0.009 to 0.014 in), each drawn as a stroke of the measured ridge width; leaves are almonds fitted to the enclosed dark interiors; everything else is a modelled shape. The reference masks of ref.js are repaired for this photograph (bronze ring and bail were swallowed by the ribbon flood, the ring hole counted as medal); see the top of the generator.
